# Active.com

> Active.com is a comprehensive event discovery and registration platform connecting athletes and outdoor enthusiasts with races, training programs, and activities across running, triathlon, cycling, and sports.

Active.com serves as the go-to resource for finding and registering for endurance events, from beginner programs like Couch to 5K to major races like IRONMAN. The platform aggregates event directories, training resources, and community features across multiple sports and fitness disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Running Races
- Triathlon Events
- IRONMAN
- Cycling Events
- Marathon Training
- Couch to 5K
- Race Registration
- Event Directory
- Outdoor Activities
- 5K Races
- Training Plans
- Hiking Trails
- Camping
- Race Calendar

## Running Races & Training

- [2024 Running Races & Race Calendar](https://www.active.com/running): Running races, calendar, training plans and articles for all abilities
- [5K Races & Runs | 5K Running | 2024 5Ks](https://www.active.com/running/5k): 5K race finder, registration and preparation resources
- [Marathons | 2024 Marathon Race Calendar](https://www.active.com/running/marathon): Marathon calendar, training tips and global runner community
- [Half Marathon | 2024 Half Marathon Races](https://www.active.com/running/half-marathon): Half marathon calendar, training plans and race guides
- [10K Runs & Races | 2024 10Ks](https://www.active.com/running/10k): 10K race directory with training articles and registration
- [Couch to 5K Program & C25K Running Schedule](https://www.active.com/running/couch-to-5k): 9-week beginner running plan transitioning to 5K races

## Triathlon Events

- [Triathlon | Triathlon Events & Races](https://www.active.com/triathlon): Triathlon race directory for IRONMAN and other events
- [Sprint Triathlon | 2024 Sprint Triathlon Events & Races](https://www.active.com/triathlon/sprint): Sprint triathlon races, training resources and event search
- [Olympic Distance Triathlon Races | International Distance Triathlon Event](https://www.active.com/triathlon/olympic/international): Olympic distance triathlon events and race information

## Cycling & Bike Racing

- [Cycling & Bike Racing | 2024 Road Cycling Events](https://www.active.com/cycling): Cycling events, bike races, training tips and century rides
- [Road Cycling Training | Cycling Road Race & Road Bike Racing](https://www.active.com/cycling/road-cycling): Road cycling races, training tips and bike racing guide
- [Mountain Biking Races & Events](https://www.active.com/cycling/mountain-biking): Mountain biking races, events and skills classes
- [Metric Century Ride | 2024 Metric Century Races](https://www.active.com/cycling/metric-century): Metric century bike rides with tips for 62-mile events

## Outdoor Activities & Adventure

- [Outdoor Activities, Campgrounds, and Hiking Trails Near You](https://www.active.com/outdoors): Outdoor activities guide with hiking trails and campgrounds
- [Hiking Events & Tips | Trails for Hiking Near You](https://www.active.com/outdoors/Hiking): Hiking trail finder with events, tips and local guides
- [Camping Events & Places to Camp | Campgrounds Near You](https://www.active.com/outdoors/camping): Camping directory with campsites and campground registration

## Team Sports & Recreation

- [Baseball Leagues, Camps & Tournaments Near You](https://www.active.com/baseball): Baseball leagues, camps, tournaments and youth sports
- [Football Camps, Leagues & Tournaments](https://www.active.com/football): Football camps, leagues, clinics and training resources
- [Golf Lessons, Camps & Tournaments Near You](https://www.active.com/golf): Golf lessons, camps and tournaments across US and Canada
